limits: Forward convolution/dense MACs exclude BN, activation, augmentation, backward pass, optimizer, compilation, input pipeline, inference and I/O overhead.
Three MAC-order representatives per task do not prove a runtime or peak-memory bound for every candidate.
Checkpoint estimate includes float32 model arrays and two Adam slots per trainable scalar; excludes metadata, scalar optimizer state, RNG, scratch files and retained calibration snapshots.
Largest single convolution output is a diagnostic, not a peak-training-memory estimate.
note: CIFAR10 maximum-parameter candidate was already among the six; extrema list is a coverage review, not a claim that all listed candidates were absent.
